component.name: spt
component.summary: Permanent SSH/SSH3 tunnels with reconnect and service integration

description.p: spt establishes and maintains permanent SSH tunnels — local and reverse port forwards that survive network drops, host restarts, service restarts, DNS changes, and normal operational drift.

ul.li: SSH2 transport via libssh2 and an experimental SSH3 transport over QUIC + HTTP/3.
Local and remote TCP forwards; UDP forwards over SSH3.
Built-in transparent DNS resolver with split-horizon and SRV synthesis.
Encrypted secret vault (AES-256-GCM + Argon2id) and OS keychain integration.
Service integration, structured observability, embedded MCP server, TUI configurator.

description.p: spt is client-only: it connects to existing SSH/SSH3 servers and maintains forwards through them.
